full_prompt_en: A large-format black-and-white landscape photograph looks across a dry, sparsely vegetated plain toward a massive thundercloud rising behind low rocky hills. The foreground starts with pale sandy ground and scattered rounded shrubs, their small highlights and dark shadows giving a tangible sense of distance. A line of angular mountains sits low across the middle, with one large rounded rock formation on the right. Almost the entire upper frame belongs to a boiling cumulonimbus tower. Its compact central column climbs from a dark heavy base into successive cauliflower-like lobes of bright white vapor. At the top, thinner streaks sweep outward into the black sky, so the cloud seems both solid and in motion. The horizon stays low and level, allowing the weather to dominate the scale while the shrubs and stone masses provide spatial anchors. Deep charcoal and nearly black tones occupy the sky and cloud undersides; brilliant silver-white edges catch light on the upper volumes; many middle grays reveal minute ripples within the vapor and rough textures on the ground. The image has the crisp detail and broad tonal range of a carefully exposed fine-art photograph, with no color cast or painterly brush texture. Side light sharply models the cloud and throws long, restrained shadows across the plain. There is no visible human activity, so the composition reads as a moment of immense atmospheric force above a still landscape. Its drama comes from the visual contrast between a very wide, quiet foreground and the towering, turbulent form that nearly fills the sky.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅大画幅黑白风景照片越过干燥而植被稀疏的平原，望向低矮岩丘后升起的巨大雷暴云。前景从浅色沙地和散落的圆灌木开始，它们细小的亮部与暗影带出切实的距离感。棱角山脉沿画面中部低低横过，右侧有一块较大的圆浑岩体。上方几乎全由翻涌的积雨云占据。紧密的中央云柱从沉重暗底升起，向上叠成一层层花椰菜般明亮白色云瓣。顶部更细薄的纹理向黑色天空外扫，让云既显结实又显运动。地平线低而平，使天气主宰尺度，灌木和岩石则提供空间锚点。深炭灰与近黑占据天空和云的底面；银白高光抓住上部体积边缘；大量中灰呈现云汽的微小起伏以及地表粗糙纹理。画面具有精心曝光的艺术摄影那种清晰细节和宽阔灰阶，没有偏色或绘画笔触质地。侧光鲜明塑出云体，并在平原上投下克制的长影。看不到人类活动，因此构图像是静止景观上方巨大大气力量的一瞬。戏剧性来自宽阔安静前景与几乎填满天空的高耸湍动形体之间的视觉反差。
style_prompt_en: Fine-art monochrome landscape photography renders immense atmospheric volume above a low, spacious horizon. The tonal scale stretches from velvety near-black to brilliant silver-white, with numerous distinct middle grays preserving texture rather than collapsing into flat contrast. Compact illuminated lobes stack into a large upward mass, while darker undersides and fine outward streaks imply turbulent motion. A small, granular foreground of scattered rounded forms and distant angular silhouettes supplies scale without competing with the sky. Side light models each swelling surface and leaves long subdued shadows. Edges remain photographically crisp where bright forms meet deep darkness, then soften gradually inside vaporous transitions. The composition is austere and expansive: still ground below, powerful textured movement above, and a disciplined balance between small earthbound detail and one monumental luminous shape.
style_prompt_zh: 艺术性黑白风景摄影在低而开阔的地平线上方呈现巨大的大气体积。灰阶从丝绒般近黑延伸到亮银白，大量可辨的中间灰保留纹理，而不坍成平板强对比。紧密受光的团块向上堆叠成大型形体，更暗的底面和细长外扫纹理暗示湍动。散布圆形小体与远方棱角剪影构成颗粒感前景，提供尺度却不与上方争夺注意。侧光塑造每个膨起表面，并留下低调长影。亮形与深暗相接处边缘有摄影的锐利，云汽内部过渡则逐渐柔化。构图简肃而广阔：下方土地静止，上方纹理强烈运动，地面细节之小与单一巨大发光形态之间保持严谨平衡。
theme_en: A towering thundercloud over a sparse desert plain and distant rocky hills
theme_zh: 稀疏荒漠平原与远方岩丘上方的高耸雷暴云
name: Mitch Dobrowner
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
